content.text:
Implemented a two-lap run in `index.html`. Lap 1 requires 8 toppings; Lap 2 requires 10, gives the maze a warmer look, and speeds up the pizza. The game resets the timer and positions for Lap 2 while carrying over score and lives, and shows a lap transition banner.

Checked JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check`. Assumption: “Make lap 2” meant adding a harder second lap to the existing game.
